name: menubar-25
description: Edit menu wired to an undo stack, disabling undo and redo when there is nothing to step through.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Redo2Icon, Undo2Icon } from "lucide-react" import { Menubar, MenubarContent, MenubarGroup, MenubarItem, MenubarMenu, MenubarShortcut, MenubarTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/menubar" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const steps = [ "Created artboard", "Added header", "Changed fill to indigo", "Grouped layers", ] export default function UndoHistoryMenubar() { const [position, setPosition] = React.useState(steps.length) return (
Edit setPosition((p) => p - 1)} > Undo {position > 0 ? steps[position - 1] : ""} ⌘Z setPosition((p) => p + 1)} > Redo {position < steps.length ? steps[position] : ""} ⇧⌘Z
    {steps.map((step, i) => (
  1. = position && "text-muted-foreground line-through" )} > {i + 1} {step}
    2. ))}
) }
